Commentary.Commentary: Right then, we are done with this thriller! West Indies Women have registered their first-ever win over England Women in the 50-over World Cup and will be on cloud nine. Heather Knight tried to stay positive in her interview but she will be feeling the heat after losing two close games. The next match is going to be between New Zealand Women and India Women on the 10th of March at 6.30 am IST (1 am GMT). Both these teams recently played a bilateral series where the White Ferns won comprehensively. Will their dominance continue or can India Women avenge the series loss with an all-important win in the mega event? Do join us to find out. As usual, our build-up will begin in advance. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Stafanie Taylor, the winning captain of West Indies Women, smiles and says that it's not something she likes (close games), it was nerve-wracking but she is happy they ended up on the winning side. Tells that they knew they had to bowl and field well. Mentions that it's important for the lower order to step up when the top order has not clicked. She is really impressed with the way Deandra Dottin took a spectacular catch at point and calls it her strength. Further adds that they try to give their best on the field and focus on the areas to improve, regardless of the opposition they are facing.

Heather Knight, the captain of England Women, says that West Indies Women batted outstandingly on a good wicket. Praises the way the English team crawled back with the ball but then they struggled to break the stand between Shemaine Campbelle and Chedean Nation. Feels that the last 10 overs cost them in the last match and the last 6-7 overs probably cost them in this match. Adds that there are a lot of things in their control that they can do better. Tells that they got to be better and she is not too worried about the two losses. Shares that it was a good wicket and they lost wickets in a cluster which eventually cost them. She wants to be more clinical with the execution of their plans. Praises Sophie Ecclestone for her knock and calls it unlucky that she failed to take the team over the line.

Shemaine Campbelle is the Player of the Match! She starts by saying that there was some pressure when she went out to bat. Tells that she tried to build a partnership and played every ball on its merit. Mentions that for them it was a matter of spending time in the middle and they knew if they do that, runs would come. On his partnership with Chedean Nation, Shemaine Campbelle replies that it was a good one and they both are quick between the wickets. Further praises her team for the work they did in the field. Adds that they took a few fantastic catches as well and did well to hold their nerves towards the end. She wants to stay focused for the coming challenge.
Presentation time...

Where did England Women lose the match? Well, it's the batting failure that has cost this game. No two ways about it. That said, after making a resounding comeback with the ball, post Powerplay 1, they allowed a century partnership to develop in the middle overs. West Indies Women recovered and posted 225 on the board that many considered to be challenging. It turned out that way as the reigning champions fell short by 7 runs. Not to forget the number of catches that went down in this match. Both teams were equally clumsy but it has cost England Women more in the end.

It was quite a straightforward chase for England Women but they never got going. Due to the fall of wickets at regular intervals, they failed to get any momentum. It was the stand between Sophia Dunkley and Danni Wyatt that offered them some hope but after a brief resistance, the English team lost 3 wickets in the span of 6 balls. That pushed them off the track completely and the writing was on the wall. Just when it appeared that they will fold out tamely, Sophie Ecclestone and Kate Cross combined for a 61-run and nearly emerged as the unlikely saviours for the defending champions. But it was not meant to be. West Indies Women held their nerves and grabbed the two wickets late to hand England Women yet another close defeat.

Deandra Dottin in the last match, Anisa Mohammed in this one, West Indies Women are picking their heroes for every game! Yet another spirited show from them and they have taken down the defending champions. By achieving two wins against two of the favourites to win this tournament, West Indies have not just gained confidence but also a position for themselves on the table that can help them in securing a safe passage to the next round. We know it's too early to say that but they have passed a couple of litmus tests and living up to the tag of being a dark horse to win this edition.

OUT! TIMBER! West Indies Women have pulled off a stunner and the Windies are pumped up here in Dunedin. Anisa Mohammed with her go-to-ball, a floated one, very full and around middle, Anya Shrubsole comes down the track and tries to flick it but she misses and the ball sneaks past her bat to disturb the stumps. West Indies Women win this nail-biter by 7 runs and Anisa Mohammed is running in celebration.
Tossed up, fuller and on off. Anya Shrubsole skips down and defends with her bat and pad together.
Fuller and around off, Sophie Ecclestone drills it down to long off for a run. 8 needed! In case of a tie, we will have a Super Over!
Anya Shrubsole is the last batter. This match is going down to the wire.

OUT! RUN OUT! There is another twist in this game! What a game this is turning out to be! A floated full ball, on middle, Sophie Ecclestone comes down the track and smashes it back to Anisa Mohammed who tries to grab the ball to her right but fails. However, she gets a touch and the ball goes on to strike the stumps at the non-striker's end. Kate Cross looked out of her crease but it is still taken upstairs. The replays show that Kate Cross is well short. West Indies Women need one wicket and England Women need 9 runs.
Appeal for a run out at the bowler's end. Anisa has got fingertips behind the ball and Kate Cross is late in getting her bat inside the crease.
Anisa Mohammed is back on.

Singles will do for England Women! A full ball, on middle, Sophie Ecclestone flicks it aerially and over Hayley Matthews at mid-wicket, who leaps up and perhaps gets fingertips to it. Good attempt though. 9 runs needed now in 18 balls.
Pitches it up, on off, Cross hits it to long on for one more.
Slower ball again, fuller and outside off. Ecclestone guides it to third man for a single.
A length ball, slower and around off. Sophie Ecclestone is happy to defend it.
A fuller ball, on middle, drilled down to long on for a single.
A fuller ball, outside off, Cross fails to get underneath it completely. It's pushed to covers.
Wide! Length ball, down the leg side. Cross misses her pull.
FOUR! Huge over for England Women, 12 runs off it! A full toss, on middle Sophie Ecclestone hammers it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary. 14 needed in 24 balls.
A length ball, slower and outside off. Ecclestone slaps it through covers and id off for a couple of runs. The game is tilting England's side.
On middle, fuller length, flicked to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Edgy runs! England Women won't mind it and it also brings up the 50-run stand between these two! A fuller ball, outside off. Ecclestone looks to drive but gets an inside edge past the keeper and to the fine leg fence.
Wide! A length ball, angling down the leg side. Ecclestone misses her flick. Dottin is interested as she puts up an appeal for caught behind but no support for her.
On a length, on off, pushed to mid off.
A length ball, angling on the pads. Cross whips it to deep square leg only for a single.
Deandra Dottin is back on. Can she do the magic again?
Slower one, full and dipping in around off, Sophie flicks across the line again but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Fullish and around off, angling in, it's flicked across the line but straight to mid-wicket.
Width on offer outside off, short in length, Cross goes on the back foot and whacks it to sweeper cover for one. 200 up! 26 needed off 32 balls.
Dot ball. Fullish and around leg, Kate tries to flick but misses and is rapped on the pads.
Slightly short and on off, Sophie stands back and whips it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Delivers it on a fuller length around middle, Cross tucks it to deep mid-wicket and runs the first run hard. That's all she will get.
Shakera Selman is back into the attack.
Full and angling in, helped to short mid-wicket. 29 needed off 36 balls. This is getting close and slipping away from West Indies Women.
Outside off, driven square of the wicket on the off side for a single.

Floated and full around off, Sophie Ecclestone lifts it over mid on and Chinelle Henry charges forward from the deep to take the catch. It though falls just short, brushes her hands and goes behind. They take a run.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps a full ball to deep square leg for a couple of runs. Slight fumble in the deep made the second run easy.
Too full in length and outside off, Cross drills it to deep cover for one.
Fuller and around off, it's dragged down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy and full, outside off, Sophie Ecclestone drives it to sweeper cover for a run. 35 needed off 42 balls.
Flighted and full outside off, Sophie goes back and mistimes her shot back to the bowler.
Short and around off, pulled with so much power to deep square leg. The fielder in the deep dived and pulled it back, saving two.
Fuller nad around leg, clipped to square leg for a run.

Appeal for an lbw! The finger goes up and Kate Cross has decided to review it. It's a nicely tossed up delivery, landing full and around leg, Cross tries to lean across and flick but misses. She is pinged on the pads, they appeal and the finger goes up. Kate takes the DRS. No bat on the UltraEdge but the Ball Tracking shows that it's turning down and would have missed the leg stump. Relief for England Women.
Short and around off, Kate Cross goes back to cut but it takes the outer edge and runs down to third man for a couple of runs.
Anisa Mohammed is brought back into the attack. 3-1-17-1 are her figures so far.
Another defensive shot off the front foot by Sophie Ecclestone to see off the over safely. This stand is now worth 29 runs and giving hope to England Women.
Full and flighted, around off, defended to the off side.
Flatter off spinner, around off, Kate tries to defend but it takes the inner edge and rolls through square leg for a run.
Turning back in from around off, with some extra bounce, Cross tries to flick but misses and is hit high on the thigh pad.
Ooohhhh...that misses the off pole by a whisker. Loopy and full, landing outside off and turning back in, Kate Cross tries to drive but is beaten on the inside edge.
Flighted delivery, short and wide outside off, Sophie slaps it to deep point for a single.
Good stop! Width there outside off, Cross slashes hard at it and forces it to point. Deandra Dottin dives across to her left to make the stop. Seems to have hurt her left hand slightly.
On a length and in the channel outside off, Kate allows it through to the keeper.

FOUR! That will ease the nerves in the English camp. Short in length and around leg, Kate Cross swivels on the back foot and helps it over backward square leg. It beats the fielder in the deep and finds the fence. 43 needed off 56 balls.
Fuller and on middle, pushed down the ground but straight to mid on.
Short this time, around off, it's pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full toss and around off, Sophie swings her bat at it and drags it off the inner half to mid-wicket.

Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this inning. West Indies Women though would like to attack with more fielders inside the 25-yard circle. Aaliyah Alleyne is back on now.
Tossed up, turning on middle. Cross sweeps it to fine leg and by the time the fielder cuts it off, the batters take two runs. 48 runs needed in 60 balls.
Shorter, quicker and around off. Cross stays back ad blocks it out.
Around off, pushed to covers.
On middle. Blocked out.
Tossed up, outside off. Cross defends it off the outer half to point.
A shorter ball, around middle, Sophie Ecclestone shuffles across and whacks it to fine leg for three runs. Had she missed that, she would have been plumb in front.
Hayley Matthews is back on. 2/27 from her 7 overs so far.

FOUR! Good shot! A fuller ball, on middle, Cross flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary. A boundary to end the spell of Shamilia Connell but still, it is an exceptional spell from her, 10-1-38-3!
Fullish and outside off. Ecclestone drives to sweeper cover for a single.
Length ball, on off. Ecclestone prods and punches it to mid off.
Fuller ball, on off. Ecclestone taps it to covers.
Wide called for height! A slower short ball, way outside off. Ecclestone watches it sail over and the umpire calls it a wide.
Touch fuller and on off, pushed to covers off the front foot.
A length ball, outside off, width available to cut. Cross offers no shot though.
Flatter, on a length, on middle. Sophie pulls it to square leg. 60 needed for a win. This is still possible for England Women but they need a partnership.
Tossed up, fuller and on off. Ecclestone smashes it straight back to Taylor.
Tossed up, on off. Ecclestone sweeps it wide of deep square leg and the batters collect a couple of runs.
Fuller ball, angling outside off. Cross drives it on the up to deep cover for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off, Ecclestone knocks it to long off for one.
Slightly short and outside off. Cross cuts it past the diving point fielder for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Ecclestone guides it straight to point. Just one from the over. 65 runs needed in 78 balls.
Over-pitched, outside off. Ecclestone works it to covers.
Fuller and on off, played back to Shamilia.
A yorker-length ball, angling on the pads. Sophie Ecclestone misses her flick. An appeal follows for LBW but it was always going down.
Fuller ball, angling on the pads, it is flicked to fine leg for a run.
Fuller ball, around off, Cross drives it to mid off.
Floated and outside off, it is hit to sweeper cover for a single.
Short again, outside off. Cross cuts it hard but finds Dottin at point.
Fuller ball, outside off. Ecclestone drives it through covers for a single.
A flighted full toss, on middle, pushed to long off for a single.
Shorter and angling across, Ecclestone punches it through covers for a single.
Tossed up, going with the angle. Sophie Ecclestone tries to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge to covers.
Full in length and outside off, Kate tries to drive but misses. End of a stupendous over.
Kate Cross is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT AT POINT! The wheels are coming off for the defending champions. Shamilia Connell feeds some width outside off and keeps the length on the shorter side. Katherine Brunt reaches out for it and tries to swat it through covers. But it takes the outer portion of the bat and flies into the hands of Deandra Dottin. It's a simple take for her this time and it has been a great turnaround for West Indies Women after the stand between Sophia Dunkley and Danni Wyatt.
Commentary.Howout: c Deandra Dottin b Shamilia Connell

Commentary.Commentary: Stays back and punches in the gap at covers for one.
Outside off, pushed to covers for a single.
Who will bat next? Sophie Ecclestone it is.

OUT! CAUGHT! A fantastic catch by Henry and England Women are staring down the barrel. Shamilia Connell delivers it full and around off, Danni Wyatt attempts to heave it over the leg side but it takes the top edge and flies behind the bowler. Chinelle Henry runs back from mid off, keeps her eyes on the ball and stretches out her hands to cup it safely. That's a superb catch. West Indies Women have been poor in the field with their catching but now have taken a few worldies as well.
Commentary.Howout: c Chinelle Henry b Shamilia Connell

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around middle, defended down the surface.
Katherine Brunt is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! The partnership that was looking dangerous for West Indies Women has been broken. Not a wicket-taking delivery. A half-tracker wide outside off, Sophia Dunkley tries to fetch it from there and pull but fails to middle her shot. It flies off the top edge and goes to short mid-wicket where Chinelle Henry jumps and catches it over her head. Sophia Dunkley departs after a quickfire knock. 72 needed off 96 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Chinelle Henry b Stafanie Taylor

Commentary.Commentary: Edgy! Full and flighted outside off, Sophia Dunkley slices her attempted drive behind backward point for a couple.
Short again outside off, Dunkley forces it from the back foot to covers.
Shortish and around off, Sophia Dunkley goes back to punch but mistimes it towards the off side.
Plays it towards extra cover and collects a single.
Short and outside off, skidding away, Sophia cuts it through covers for a run.
Fuller and outside off, Sophia strokes it through covers for a run. 7 from the over, 150 comes up for England Women.
FOUR! Fine placement. Short in length and wide outside off, plenty of room available, Sophia Dunkley camps back and smacks it through point for a cracking boundary.
Fuller in length around middle and leg, Danni Wyatt picks it off her pads and flicks it a bit aerially. It goes wide of mid-wicket and travels to long on. They cross.
Beaten! This one lands on a length outside off and zips off the surface, Danni Wyatt tries driving but misses.
A bumper outside off, Danni Wyatt tries to ramp it over the keeper but fails.
Width on offer outside off, Sophia Dunkley guides it down to third man for a run. The 50-run stand comes up! 82 needed off 107 balls.
Tossed up and around off, defended to the off side. 8 from the over!
Too full in length and outside off, Sophia Dunkley gets forward and drills it down to long off for a run.
Short and around off, turning away, Sophia Dunkley forces it to sweeper cover and scampers back for the second run.
Flatter and quicker outside off, Danni Wyatt goes for a big shot across the line but gets a top edge. It flies towards mid on and the catch gets dropped. Doesn't matter though. They get a run.
NO BALL! Stafanie Taylor loses control and serves it outside the pitch. Danni Wyatt leaves and the umpire calls for a no ball. Free Hit coming...
Full toss outside off, knocked down to long off again for a run.
Fuller and outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
Wide! A touch short and too wide outside off, it's left alone by the batter.
Stafanie Taylor brings herself into the attack.
Fullish and on middle, helped to short mid-wicket.
Short in length and wide outside off, Danni cuts it through point for a single.
Fuller in length, around leg, it's worked to square leg for a single.

FOUR! Excellent shot! Shakera Selman serves it on a good length outside off, Sophia Dunkley walks down the pitch, goes down on one knee and powers it over mid-wicket for a boundary. She has brought positivity to the crease.
Pitches it up and around off, Sophia Dunkley defends it back.
Slower one, on a length and around off, Danni Wyatt plays it with an angled bat to point for a brisk single.
Short ball now, on middle. Sophia sits under it.
Short of a length, on off. Wyatt taps it to point for a single.
Leg bye. Full and on the pads. Dunkley misses her flick and gets hit on the pads. It goes off the pads to the leg side.
Full ball, outside off. Dunkley drives it through covers for a brace now.

FOUR! Deandra Dottin angles in a full ball around off, Sophia Dunkley goes for a big shot but doesn't entirely get hold of it. The ball flies and lands wide of mid on and then scoots away. Chinelle Henry chases and tries to pull it back in but fails. She goes on to collide with the advertisement board and seems to have hurt herself a bit.
NO BALL! A length ball, outside off. Dunkley swings across and hits it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Deandra Dottin has overstepped, it's a no ball and Free Hit is coming up.
On a driving length, outside off. Dunkley leans and drives but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls back to Dottin.
Change! Deandra Dottin has been handed over the ball. She bowls very rarely these days but did bowl a magical last over to help West Indies Women topple the White Ferns in the tournament opener.
A length ball, outside off. Sophia works it to covers for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Dunkley tucks it to mid-wicket and looks for a quick single but it is not available there.

On middle, this is flicked to mid-wicket. Stafanie Taylor tried to take off but stuttered a bit and lost her balance. Did well to stop the ball. Laughter all around as Taylor sees the funny side of it.
Length, outside off. Defended out.
On a length, nipping back in and Dunkley, on her toes, defends it out.
On a length, on off. Danni punches with soft hands to cover for one.
Fuller ball, outside off. Dunkley steps forward and drives it to extra cover.
Around off. Wyatt stays low and waits for the ball to arrive, dabs it to short third man for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Dunkley skips down and drills it past the bowler to long off for a single.
Short ball, outside off. Danni again plays it to deep cover for a single.
Short again, stays low off the deck. Wyatt cuts it wide of deep cover and a couple of runs are taken.
A full ball, outside off. Dunkley slaps it through point for a single.

Drinks break. West Indies Women continue to keep a firm hold on this match. Timely breakthroughs right through the innings have handed them the advantage and with England Women five down, the girls from the Caribbean nation hold all the aces. That said, the reigning champions would be hoping for one steady partnership and they can still come back. The asking rate is not an issue as of now.
On a length, outside off. Dunkley presses forward to defend in front of point. A quick single is taken by the batters.
Fullish, around off. Dunkley punches it to mid on.
A length ball, outside off. Wyatt cuts it to backward point for a quick single.
Wide! Selman tries to bowl it slower but serves it down the leg side. Wide given.
Stafanie Taylor is loosening up. Maybe, she is thinking of bowling.
Pitched up, around off, driven to covers this time.
Full ball, straight on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
On a length, on middle. Dunkley turns it to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! 11 runs off the over but also a big wicket of Tammy Beaumont in it! Eventful one! A fuller ball, outside off. Wyatt smashes it well over mid off for a boundary.
Very full but Sophia Dunkley gets into the position quickly as she paddles it to short fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Dunkley with intent! Shorter ball, outside off. Dunkley gets on the back foot and cuts it through point for a boundary. 100 up for England Women.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Dunkley paddles it to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Sophia Dunkley walks in next. 132 needed off 148 balls. A slip is in place...

OUT! LBW! This one looked plumb unless there was a bat on it. No bat there and that is the end of the fighting knock from Beaumont. A full ball, very full and on middle. Tammy Beaumont comes down the track and looks to whip it across the line but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal is made and the finger goes up immediately. Tammy Beaumont was quick to take it upstairs. No bat there clearly and Ball Tracking shows three reds, which means the set batter, Tammy Beaumont, has to go back.

DRS time! Huge shout for an lbw and this time the finger has gone up. Tammy Beaumont has decided to review the decision. No bat, confirms the UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows that it's crashing on the middle stump. Three reds and it's a body blow to England Women.
A flighted ball, on middle. Tammy Beaumont drills it to short mid-wicket.
Fractionally short and on middle, Tammy Beaumont quietly nudges it behind square leg and runs the first run hard. That's all she will get. 132 runs needed at the halfway mark.
Around off, on a length and angling in, Tammy Beaumont defends it by getting on the front leg.
Very full and around off, Danni Wyatt drills it back to the bowler who deflects it off her boot. It rolls wide of mid on and they cross.
Fullish and around leg, it's flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Slower one, on a length and around middle, Danni Wyatt defends it back to the bowler.
Begins her spell with a short ball outside off, Beaumont pulls it behind square leg for a run.
Change! Shakera Selman is into the attack as well.
Tossed up, full and on off, Danni Wyatt presses forward and defends it back.

NOT OUT! Loopy and full, around off, Tammy Beaumont walks down the track to flick but misses. She is beaten and rapped on the pads. The appeal is made but nothing from the umpire. West Indies Women opt for the DRS. UltraEdge finds no bat. Time for the Ball Tracking. After a bit of a delay, it comes on the screen. The IMPACT IS OUTSIDE OFF and it's the umpire's call on hitting the wickets. The onfield call stays. One leg bye added to the total.
Shout for an lbw! The finger has stayed down and West Indies Women have referred the decision.
Loopy and full, around off, Tammy strides forward and drives it back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, Tammy Beaumont goes back and plays a mistimed cut to point.
Gets on the front foot to a full all and pushes it gently to covers.
Starts with a tossed-up delivery, around off, Tammy Beaumont defends it to the off side.
Change in bowling. Anisa Mohammed comes into the attack now.

FOUR! This is so well played by Danni! Width there outside off, short in length, Danni Wyatt latches onto it and rifles her square cut through point. It just scoots away to the fence in no time. 136 needed off 162 balls.
EDGY FOUR! A low full toss outside off, Danni Wyatt reaches out to drive it through the line but it takes the outside edge and races wide of first slip for a boundary.
Shortish and on off, Beaumont goes back and plays it down towards cover-point for a run.
Serves it on a length and close to off, some extra bounce there, Tammy defends it from the splice of her bat.
Fuller and on off, Tammy defends it near her front pad and keeps it out towards mid-wicket.
On a good length and close to off, Danni Wyatt stays back and taps it down in the gap at covers for a run.
Short in length and outside off, Danni Wyatt chops her attempted square cut towards cover-point and takes a run.
Loopy and very full on off, Tammy forces it past the short mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Tossed up, on middle, defended back.
Too full and around off, Danni Wyatt drives it through the gap at extra cover. It travels in acres of space but doesn't have the legs to cross the fence. Three taken.
Loopy and full around off, Danni Wyatt plays a cheeky paddle sweep down to fine leg for two.
Tossed up around off, worked with the spin in front of square leg for a single.
Danni Wyatt is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! West Indies Women are on fire! Aaliyah Alleyne spears in a very full ball on middle, it lands and straightens a tad as Amy Jones shapes up to drive it down the ground. The ball moves away to take the outside edge and Hayley Matthews grabs a sharp catch at first slip. With so many catches going down, this certainly is the one to please the fans of the West Indian team. 154 needed off 174 balls and England Women are under the pump.
Commentary.Howout: c Hayley Matthews b Aaliyah Alleyne

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and outside off, driven through cover-point for a single.
Play and a miss! Width there outside off, short in length, Tammy Beaumont flashes at it and misses. It's called a WIDE and Aaliyah Alleyne cannot believe it. That was a harsh call, to be honest.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Tammy defends it with an angled bat to covers.
Fullish and around off, it's pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Those quick hands of Tammy Beaumont. Wow. She picks the short ball in a trice, hangs on the back foot and pummels it behind square leg for a boundary.

Aerial but safe! England Women are living dangerously at the moment. Fuller and around off, Tammy Beaumont tries to flick but close the face of her bat early. It comes off the leading edge and goes wide of the bowler to mid off.
Fuller ball, outside off. Defended out.
On middle, worked to mid-wicket.
An arm ball, fuller ball, and on off. Tammy Beaumont comes down the track and whips it to the left of short mid-wicket where the fielder dives but the ball was just wide of her reach. A single taken.
This one does not turn much. Jones plays with an open face of the bat, through short third man for one.
Shorter ball, outside off, turning in and Jones cuts it to point.
Tossed up, outside off. Tammy turns it to square leg for a single.
Length ball, on off. Jones is early as she punches it to covers.

Chance there! A fuller ball, around off. Jones drives it uppishly and back to Aaliyah Alleyne. It's very low and tough for Alleyne to catch it on her follow-through but that should have been taken. Another dropped catch in this match.
On a length, on middle. Jones stays back and tucks it on the leg side.
Pitches it up, on middle. Jones hits it to mid on. Dot balls piling up. Pressure on England Women.
On a driving length, outside off. Jones pushes it to covers.
A fuller ball, around off. Jones dead-bats it on the deck.
Fuller again, keeping it outside off. Tammy Beaumont shuffles across and defends it out. 163 needed in 192 balls.
Another solid defensive prod from Tammy Beaumont.
Fuller and around off. Tammy Beaumont steps across and bunts it on the leg side.
Spin again here and Tammy Beaumont waits and plays it to mid-wicket.
Fuller again, spinning in, outside off. Tammy Beaumont steps forward and blocks it out.
FOUR! Much needed boundary! Streaky one though! Tossed up, outside off. Tammy Beaumont comes forward to defend but she gets an outside edge to third man for a boundary.
On a length, outside off. Jones lets it go to the keeper.
Fuller again, on off. Jones drives it to covers where the fielder dives to stop it.
Angles a fuller ball, on middle. Kept out.
A low full toss, on off. Jones pushes it to mid off.
Length ball, outside off. Tammy Beaumont drops it to point for a quick single.
Full ball, way outside off. Left alone.
Amy Jones walks in next. 168 needed off 204 balls.

OUT! CAUGHT! Just when a partnership was building, West Indies Women find a way to break it. Tossed up, fuller and around off. Natalie Sciver kneels and tries to slog-sweep it over the leg side but ends up mistiming it from the upper half of her blade to mid on. Aaliyah Alleyne is stationed there and she tracks back and takes the catch over her head. England Women are in a spot of bother.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaliyah Alleyne b Hayley Matthews

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, outside off. Tammy Beaumont skips down and whips it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on middle, flicked to square leg.
Tossed up, around off. Tammy Beaumont heaves it in the air but the ball does not travel the distance. Easily cut out. Two runs taken.
Shorter again, coming with the angle and Beaumont punches it to point.
Shorter and outside off, cut away to point.
Length this time, outside off. This is worked through the cover region for a single.
FOUR! First boundary since the 4th over! A half-tracker from Aaliyah Alleyne around off stump. Beaumont plays a controlled pull shot and gets a boundary down to the mid-wicket fence.
Very full, on off. Beaumont keeps it out.
Full again, around off. Beaumont pushes it out towards cover.
Full, on the fifth stump. Beaumont leaves it alone.
This is banged in short, on off. Tammy Beaumont pulls it through mid-wicket but doesn't get great timing on it. Two taken and the 50 is up for England Women.

Drinks! West Indies Women are on the front foot currently as they have not allowed much flow of runs. Tammy Beaumont has spent some time in the middle but she needs support and Natalie Sciver will try to help build a partnership here.
Nicely flighted, around off. Sciver puts a big stride forward to defend it out.
On a shorter length, on off. Beaumont works it off the back foot through mid-wicket for one.
This is looped up, around off, inviting the big shot. Beaumont though stays solid in defense.
Flatter, on off. Beaumont defends it out.
Tossed up, on off. Tammy Beaumont skips down the track and lofts it in front of square on the leg side for a brace.
Dragged down, on off and turning into the right-hander. Natalie Sciver rocks back and heaves it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and straight, driven towards wide mid on for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Sciver hangs back and squeezes it out towards backward point.
WIDE! This is short and wide, shaping further away. Wide signalled.
On middle and leg, worked towards wide mid on.
A bit of extra bounce this time! Length ball, outside off and Sciver gets undone by the extra bounce as she looks to cut.
Leg bye! This is on the pads, Beaumont looks to flick it away but the ball comes off the pads and goes towards fine leg. They get a leg bye.
Fullish delivery, on off. This is pushed towards mid off.
Tossed up, outside off. Sciver defends it out.
Flatter and outside off, punched to covers.
Fuller and on off. Sciver blocks it.
Natalie Sciver walks out to the middle.

Stumping appeal! UltraEdge shows a spike as the ball passes the bat but the umpire feels the bat brushed the pad at the same time as well. After another replay, the umpire goes back with the side angle and it shows there was a gap between the bat and pad. So, that tickle was between bat and ball. OUT is the result.

OUT! Well, well! The appeal was originally for stumping but the catch was also checked and Windies get the breakthrough. Peach of a delivery to start with from Hayley Matthews. This is drifted in on a length, slightly wide of the off stump. Heather Knight is pushed forward but the ball just holds its line. The keeper Shemaine Campbelle whips off the bails and the umpire goes upstairs. The third umpire checks for the catch first and there is a spike on UltraEdge but it is a difficult decision as the bat almost clipped the pads at the same time as well. The third umpire has a long hard look at it and is convinced that the spike is generated by the contact of the ball with the bat. Heather Knight has to depart.
Commentary.Howout: c Shemaine Campbelle b Hayley Matthews

Commentary.Commentary: Easy two! Flighted, around off. Knight gets inside the line of the ball and paddles it fine for a couple of runs.
Flatter, around off. Knight strides out to defend.
Shorter and slower, outside off. Knight fetches it and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length again, Knight rocks back and carves it to the right of point but Deandra Dottin makes a fabulous diving stop over there.
500 Women's World Cup runs up for Tammy Beaumont! Back of a length, around off. This is punched off the back foot to deep point for one more.
WIDE! An attempted bumper this time, down the leg side. Wided.
Length again, well outside off. Knight hangs back and dabs it through point for a run.
Around the top of off. Knight has to hop on the back foot to block it out.
Short and wide, tapped through cover-point for a single.
Powerplay 1 is done! The fielding side can now have up to 4 fielders outside the inner ring till the 40th over.
Floated, full and outside off, pushed straight to mid off.
Very full this time and it is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Shorter, slower and outside off. Knight plays it late and in the gap, to backward point for a single.
Full ball, outside off. Tammy Beaumont gets across and paddles it to fine leg for a single.
A flatter ball, on off. Beaumont prods to defend but gets an inside edge and the ball drops on the surface.
Tossed up, full and on middle. Beaumont pushes it to mid on.
Hayley Matthews is brought into the attack now.
A length ball, outside off. Knight stays back and nudges it towards point.
Length and on off. Knight punches it to point.
Around off, this is hit to point.
Short of a length, outside off. Knight looks to cut but bottom edges it to the keeper, who collects it on a bounce.
A length ball, outside off. Left alone.
The skipper, Heather Knight is in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! An absolute screamer from Deandra Dottin! All the dropped catches in this match and Deandra Dottin pulls out a gold medal catch. A length ball, outside off, width on offer there and Lauren Winfield latches onto it. She cuts it uppishly and to the left of point where Deandra Dottin dives that side and takes a one-handed blinder. She does well to hold onto it while getting down. West Indies Women have a breakthrough here.
Commentary.Howout: c Deandra Dottin b Shamilia Connell

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, slower and outside off. Winfield cuts it past point and gets a single.
A solid defense from Lauren Winfield.
Outside off, on a length. worked to point for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Beaumont on her front foot, defends off the outer half to point.
Fuller ball, on off. Tammy Beaumont pushes it back to Henry who does well to stop in her follow-through.
On a length, on off, pulled away to mid-wicket.
Length ball, outside off. Winfield punches it to covers.
Around off, tapped to point for a quick single.
Nice looking shot! Fuller ball, outside off, drive to deep cover where the fielder dives to her right and stop it. Two runs taken.

Dropped! Add another one to the drop tally of today! Short of a length, outside off. Lauren Winfield cuts it hard and aerially towards backward point where Deandra Dottin leaps up and tries to grab it in the air but only manages to palm it over. A single taken.
Length ball, outside off. Winfield watchfully blocks it to point.
A length ball, outside off, nipping away a bit. Winfield goes for a big booming drive and misses.
Pitched up, outside off, pushed to covers.
Fuller ball, outside off. Tammy Beaumont leans and drives it but straight to covers.
Width given, outside off. Winfield cuts it to deep point for a single.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Winfield waits for it and then punches it late to point for a quick single. Shakera Selman while backing up just hurts herself in the process.
A length ball, on the pads. Winfield clips it to short fine leg.
A length ball, around off. Winfield guides it down to third man for a single.

DROPPED! How many dropped catches will we see in this match? On a nagging length, around off. Tammy Beaumont leans in to drive but gets caught on the crease. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards first slip at some pace. Anisa Mohammed over there is slow to react and spills the catch. The batters get a single.
WIDE! Another wide! Fullish ball, well outside off.
Around the top of off, pushed towards covers for one.
A run out appeal! A direct hit by the keeper at the non-striker's end but Tammy Beaumont did really well to stride her bat inside the crease.

SAFE! Good cricket all around! A bit short and wide, Lauren Winfield gets onto the back foot quickly and slaps it through backward point. She wants the second and they push hard for it. Winfield is safe at the keeper's end where the throw comes in but the keeper does well to score a direct hit at the opposite end. Tammy Beaumont was a bit slow and the umpires go upstairs. The replays show that Beaumont made it in time.
Back of a length, close to the off pole this time. Winfield hops and taps it towards point.
Pitched up, outside off. Winfield looks to drive but gets it off the inner half of the bat back towards the bowler.
Around middle, this is tucked away to mid-wicket.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings and it is nicely timed by Tammy Beaumont. Pitched up, on off. Beaumont leans in and punches it through extra cover for a boundary.
Just inside the tramline this time. Full and wide, left alone by Beaumont.
WIDE! Oh, dear! This is even wider than the last one. The ball pitches beyond the tramline and shapes further away. The keeper collects it around first slip.
WIDE! This is poor bowling from the Windies pacers. Fullish delivery, spilled beyond the tramline for another wide.
Outside off and this is tapped through cover-point for a single by Winfield.
WIDE! Full and wide, a bit too wide though for the umpire's liking.
Length this time, around off. Winfield hangs back and nudges it out on the off side.
Pitched up, on off. Winfield pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Touch fuller, around off and left alone by Beaumont.
Short and wide, Beaumont's eyes lit up and she cuts it hard but straight to the fielder at point.
Good-length again, around off. Beaumont blocks it out on the off side.
Width on offer and Lauren Winfield throws her hands at it. The ball flies off the outside edge down towards the third man region. They get a single.
Around the top of off, punched away towards cover.
A good length ball, on off. This one jams back in sharply off the surface. Beaumont adjusts well and nudges it towards silly mid on for a quick single.
On a driving length, around off and this is pushed towards covers for a run. Beaumont is off the mark now.
Well outside off, Beaumont sees the width and goes chasing after it. She doesn't reach it though.
Henry hits the length hard and bowls it around off. Beaumont looks to take on the pull shot but mistimes it badly towards mid on.
Length, around off and Beaumont lets it through to the keeper.
Tammy Beaumont has a smile on her face as she cannot believe the umpire didn't call that a wide. This is full and well outside off, shaping away too. No wide called.
A bit shorter and outside off. Winfield stands tall and taps it to the left of extra cover for a single.
Chinelle Henry to bowl from the other end.
Good-length, outside off and nipping back in off the surface. Lauren Winfield hangs back and steers it through backward point for a single. She is underway.
WIDE! A third extra in the over. On a shorter length and pushed beyond the tramline once again.
Length, outside off and left alone.
Much better from Connell! Pitches it up, outside off. Lauren Winfield is suckered into playing the drive but gets beaten past the outside edge as the ball moves a bit in the air.
WIDE! Shades of the last match from Shamilia Connell as she continues to struggle with her line. Shorter and spilled well beyond the tramline. Wided.
On a good length this time, outside off. Winfield watches it all the way through and leaves it alone.
A length ball, outside off and shaping away a bit. Winfield looks to cut but misses.
WIDE! This is a round-arm delivery, pushed well outside off. Wide signalled.
Connell starts off with a back of a length delivery, outside off. This one jags back in and Lauren Winfield does well to dab it down towards the gully region.
